_note: What the player can do with furniture inside buildings, and what it costs in time, coin and the law (player/furnitureActions.js; the menu: ui/objectActions). 'offers' adds a furniture type's actions over the built-in table (ui/objectActions/data.js FURNITURE_ACTIONS); 'decorOffers' adds actions for what stands on a piece (tile._decor: books on a table, mugs in a tavern). 'hours' is game time; effects are needs (energy, comfort, fun, hygiene, hunger, social).
_offers: In someone else's building the dresser, cupboard, wardrobe, basket and stores are theirs (ui/objectActions/data.js PRIVATE_FURNITURE): only Look Inside (and take or steal: systems/containers.js). Your own open as storage, where Eat from the Larder finds the food you put by.
_ownership: Whose a building is decides what you may do in it: 'own' (yours), 'lodging' (an inn, tavern or guest house: its rooms are let), 'public' (anyone may come in and sit), 'home' (someone else's house: their bed and washstand are theirs), 'business' (a shop or workshop). Anything else counts as 'business'.

sleep.notYours: This isn't your bed. The household hasn't offered it.
sleep.caught: {who} finds you in their bed and throws you out. Fined {fine}g for trespass{rep}.
sleep.unseen: Nobody found you in a stranger's bed.

warm.unlit: The fire is out: there's no warmth in it.
warm.text: You warm your hands at the {what}.
warm.thawed: The chill goes out of your bones.

order_meal.poor: A meal is {cost} gold, and you haven't got it.

eat_home.empty: There's nothing to eat in the house: put food away in your chests and cupboards first.
eat_home.notHome: Only at your own table: here you would have to buy a meal.

wash_basin.notYours: It's the household's washstand, not yours.
wash_basin.text: You splash your face and scrub your hands at the basin.

_broken: A broken piece (furniture.broken: wrecked in a raid or a fire, world/innerMap/interiorState.js) is no bed, seat, fire or bench any more: every action but those in 'allow' is greyed out with its type's words (byType), else 'text'. Furniture can't be mended yet.

broken.text: The {what} is broken: no use to anyone until it is mended.

byType.bed: The bed is broken: its frame has given way and the slats lie on the floor. There's no sleeping in it.
byType.bed_1x2: The bed is broken: its frame has given way and the slats lie on the floor. There's no sleeping in it.
byType.chair: The chair is broken: a leg snapped off. It won't take your weight.
byType.stool: The stool is broken: it won't take your weight.
byType.bench: The bench is broken: split along its length, it won't take your weight.
byType.pew: The pew is broken: split along its length, it won't take your weight.
byType.table: The table is broken: it stands askew on a snapped leg.
byType.desk: The desk is broken: it stands askew on a snapped leg.
byType.fireplace: The hearth is broken: its stones are cracked and fallen in.
byType.oven: The oven is broken: its dome has cracked through.
byType.tub: The tub is broken: its staves have sprung, and it won't hold water.
byType.washstand: The washstand is broken: its basin lies cracked.
byType.workbench: The workbench is broken: there's nothing true left to work on.
byType.loom: The loom is broken: its frame is smashed and its warp cut.
byType.spinning_wheel: The spinning wheel is broken: its spokes are snapped.
byType.cradle: The cradle is broken: no child should lie in it.

bathe_tub.notYours: It's the household's bathtub, not yours.
bathe_tub.text: You fill the tub and soak until the water goes cold.

_guests: Being welcome under someone else's roof (player/guests.js; asked in the talk: ui/npcDialog/guests.js). Their beds and washstand are yours to use without a trespass where the household takes you in unasked: your parents' house (Born to a Family), your kin's (a family tie in your relationships, unless estranged below kinMin), a friend's (relationship score from friendMin, or their street regard from friendDisposition) — or where they have asked you to stay the night. A stranger says yes by their regard (0-100): certainly from yesFrom, never under askFrom, a roll between. A lord of a seat by regard plus your renown (1 point per lordRenownPer, up to lordRenownMax) and lordTitle for holding a title, yes from lordYesFrom. regard: what each call does to their regard. visit/meal: hours at it and needs met (a meal is portion units of food from the household's own larder: systems/townTrade.js serveGuest; a bare larder gives the thin meal). stay.nights: how long a night's welcome lasts.

lines.parents: This is your home. Your bed is where it always was.
lines.kin: You never need ask. Family sleeps under this roof.
lines.friend: You needn't ask, friend. Stay as long as you like.
lines.visitYes: Come by whenever you like. The door's on the latch.
lines.visitHere: You sit a while with {who} and the talk runs on.
lines.mealYes: Sit down, there's enough for one more.
lines.mealThin: There's little enough in the house, but you're welcome to share it.
lines.stayYes: There's a bed for you tonight. Don't mind the snoring.
lines.lordYes: {who} will have a bed made up for you. You are the house's guest tonight.
lines.no: I'd rather not. Find yourself a room at the inn.
lines.lordNo: My lord keeps no lodging for passing strangers.
lines.notHome: We've no house in this town to ask you into.
